title: Card spec: super.plot
description: The spec of a `super.plot` card. A statistical plot (bar, line, scatter, histogram, box, heatmap and more) the user can read, hover and export. Send the plot spec and a sentence saying what it shows. Name the title, axes and series the way the user would, not by column keys. Structure only. A value this schema accepts can still be refused by the validator: rules across fields (duplicates, a tool result that answers no call, ordering, limits that count UTF-16 units) are checked by the validators and pinned by conformance/protocol.v1.json, not here. A value the validators accept always validates.

id.description: Stable id so later tool calls can address this plot. Not shown to the user.

title.description: Shown above the plot, in the user's words: "Revenue by region", not "revenue_by_region".

spec.description: The plot spec: data, chart type and encodings. Give axes and series readable labels, not raw column keys.

alt.description: What the plot shows, in plain words: the main values and the takeaway. Read by screen readers and shown to the user if the plot cannot be drawn.
